## Description

Use smoothed synthetic candle values to filter direction and define trend persistence.

## Where it may fit

Trends with noisy candles; less useful for precise fill prices or fast reversals.

## Vehicles

Futures, FX, equity ETFs, crypto.

## Required data

OHLC bars and exact synthetic-candle formulas; raw prices for execution.

## Caveats

Heikin-Ashi prices are synthetic and must not be used as executable fill prices.
